name: Hourly EMA/RSI/Force Index trend system
author: Ituglobal
entry_long: Long when EMA(5) crosses above EMA(12), RSI(14)>50 and Force Index(14)>0.
entry_short: Short when EMA(5) crosses below EMA(12), RSI(14)<50 and Force Index(14)<0.
exit: 100-pip stop; 250-pip target; close on stop, breakeven/trailing stop, or target.
position_sizing: 0.01 lots per $2,000 capital per source; source separately states 0.5% risk per trade.
implementation_notes: Source gives example lot sizing 0.01 lots per $2,000 and 0.5% risk; forum claim, no independent validation.
